package cardrpg

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	attr "example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/gameplay/attribute"
	frameworkattr "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/gameplay/attribute"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestCardRPGCatalogReloadIsAtomicAndFrozenRulesRemainUsable(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	write := func(r Rules) {
		t.Helper()
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(r)
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "cards.json"), raw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	original := DemoRules()
	write(original)
	store, err := OpenCatalog(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshot := store.Current()
	captured, err := CaptureRules(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bad := original
	bad.Heroes[0].Attack = 0
	write(bad)
	if _, err := store.Reload(context.Background()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid content published")
	}
	if store.Current() != snapshot {
		t.Fatal("failed reload replaced snapshot")
	}
	patched := original
	patched.Version = "cards-v2"
	patched.DrawCost = 3
	patched.Heroes[0].Attack = 70
	write(patched)
	if _, err := store.Reload(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	current, err := CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if err != nil || current.Hash() == captured.Hash() || captured != original {
		t.Fatal("mixed or stale config")
	}
	if old, err := CaptureRules(snapshot); err != nil || old != original {
		t.Fatal("published snapshot mutated")
	}
}
func TestCardRPGGeneratedAttributesDeriveAndSnapshotIsIndependent(t *testing.T) {
	p := &attr.HeroStats{}
	p.SetHP(100)
	p.SetAttack(20)
	p.SetArmor(5)
	p.SetSpeed(10)
	p.Update()
	if p.Power != 65 {
		t.Fatal("generated formula not used", p.Power)
	}
	container := frameworkattr.NewContainer()
	container.Install(frameworkattr.Final, p)
	snap := container.Snapshot(frameworkattr.Final)
	p.SetAttack(40)
	p.Update()
	old, ok := snap.Profile.(*attr.HeroStats)
	if !ok || old.Attack != 20 || old.Power != 65 || p.Power != 105 {
		t.Fatal("snapshot aliases live profile")
	}
}
func TestCardRPGPrivateKeysNeverAppearInPublicProjection(t *testing.T) {
	key := strings.Repeat("ab", 32)
	p, err := NewProfile(key, 1800000000000)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := p.Draw(1, 10, DemoRules()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(p.View())
	for _, private := range []string{key, "DrawKey", "Draws", "Operations"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(raw), private) {
			t.Fatal("private field exposed", private)
		}
	}
	units, err := p.TeamUnits(DemoRules())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, err := NewBattle(1, 2, 1, 1, DemoRules(), units, p.BattleSeed(1), 1800000000000)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _ = json.Marshal(b.View())
	for _, private := range []string{"InitialSeed", "RNG", "Rules", "Log"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(raw), private) {
			t.Fatal("private battle detail exposed", private)
		}
	}
}
func TestCardRPGMalformedStateAndFrozenBattleTamperingFailClosed(t *testing.T) {
	key := strings.Repeat("ab", 32)
	p, err := NewProfile(key, 1800000000000)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := DecodeProfile(p.Encode() + "{}"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("trailing JSON accepted")
	}
	units, err := p.TeamUnits(DemoRules())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, err := NewBattle(1, 2, 1, 1, DemoRules(), units, p.BattleSeed(1), 1800000000000)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := b.Apply(TurnCommand{Seq: 1, ActorID: 1, Kind: "auto"}, 1800000000001); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := DecodeBattle(b.Encode()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b.State.Units[0].HP--
	if _, err := DecodeBattle(b.Encode()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed checkpoint accepted")
	}
	b.State.Units[0].HP++
	b.Rules.Heroes[0].Attack++
	if _, err := DecodeBattle(b.Encode()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed frozen rules accepted")
	}
}
